```{r panel-description, echo=FALSE}
description <- "
Panel N: AN05B102 -- a parallel cholinergic ascending relay for ppk23/ppk25
===========================================================================
Mirrors Panel B's AN09B017 analysis but for the AN05B102 family, which is
cholinergic (acetylcholine) rather than AN09B017's glutamatergic identity.
AN05B102 variants are present in Figure 5's underlying path feathers but are
not displayed in Panels B/K because the story was scoped to AN09B017.

Left:  Scatter of ppk23 vs ppk25 input (input-normalized fraction) per
       AN05B102 variant (a-d), with y=x diagonal; points coloured by
       dominant input.
Right: Log2 ppk23/ppk25 input-ratio bar per variant.
"
pdir <- panel_plot_dir("panel_N_description", "txt")

```

## Query AN05B102 connectivity from connectome

```{r an05b102-connectivity}
# Discover AN05B102 variants dynamically from mba (no hard-coded list — robust
# against future additions).
an05b102_types <- sort(unique(mba$type[grepl("^AN05B102", mba$type)]))
cat("AN05B102 variants found:", paste(an05b102_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Sanity-check NT identity (must be cholinergic for this panel's framing).
nt_check <- mba %>%
  dplyr::select(type, consensus_nt) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(type %in% an05b102_types)
print(nt_check)

# ppk23/ppk25 sensory neuron types from shared setup.
ppk23_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk23"]]
ppk25_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk25"]]

# Input-normalized weights: adj.matrix[pre, post] = fraction of post's total
# input contributed by the presynaptic type. Sum over all ppk23/ppk25 sensory
# partners per AN05B102 variant.
adj_rows <- rownames(adj.matrix)
adj_cols <- colnames(adj.matrix)

ppk23_to_an05b102 <- data.frame(
  post_type = an05b102_types,
  ppk23_input = sapply(an05b102_types, function(an) {
    ppk_in_mat <- ppk23_types[ppk23_types %in% adj_rows]
    if (length(ppk_in_mat) > 0 && an %in% adj_cols)
      sum(adj.matrix[ppk_in_mat, an])
    else 0
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ppk25_to_an05b102 <- data.frame(
  post_type = an05b102_types,
  ppk25_input = sapply(an05b102_types, function(an) {
    ppk_in_mat <- ppk25_types[ppk25_types %in% adj_rows]
    if (length(ppk_in_mat) > 0 && an %in% adj_cols)
      sum(adj.matrix[ppk_in_mat, an])
    else 0
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

an05b102_inputs <- data.frame(type = an05b102_types, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ppk23_to_an05b102, by = c("type" = "post_type")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ppk25_to_an05b102, by = c("type" = "post_type")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ppk23_input = tidyr::replace_na(ppk23_input, 0),
    ppk25_input = tidyr::replace_na(ppk25_input, 0),
    ratio = ifelse(ppk25_input > 0, ppk23_input / ppk25_input, Inf),
    dominant = dplyr::case_when(
      ppk23_input > ppk25_input * 1.5 ~ "ppk23-biased",
      ppk25_input > ppk23_input * 1.5 ~ "ppk25-biased",
      TRUE ~ "balanced"
    ),
    label = sub("AN05B102", "", type)
  )

cat("\nAN05B102 input profiles:\n")
print(an05b102_inputs %>% dplyr::select(type, ppk23_input, ppk25_input, ratio, dominant))
```

## Scatter: ppk23 vs ppk25 input per AN05B102 variant

```{r scatter, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
selectivity_colors <- c(
  "ppk23-biased" = "#FFD92F",
  "ppk25-biased" = "#E5C494",
  "balanced"     = "#999999"
)

p_scatter <- ggplot(an05b102_inputs, aes(x = ppk23_input, y = ppk25_input,
                                         color = dominant)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = selectivity_colors) +
  labs(x = "ppk23 input (fraction of total input)",
       y = "ppk25 input (fraction of total input)",
       color = "Selectivity") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig5_plot(p_scatter, "panel_N_an05b102_selectivity", width = 7, height = 7)
print(p_scatter)
```

## Log2 ppk23/ppk25 ratio bar

```{r ratio-bars, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
p_ratio <- ggplot(an05b102_inputs %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(ratio)),
                  aes(x = reorder(type, ratio), y = log2(ratio), fill = dominant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selectivity_colors) +
  labs(x = "AN05B102 variant",
       y = expression(log[2] * "(ppk23/ppk25 input ratio)"),
       fill = "Selectivity") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig5_plot(p_ratio, "panel_N_an05b102_selectivity_ratio", width = 8, height = 5)
print(p_ratio)
```

## Panel narrative

```{r narrative, echo=FALSE}
n_variants     <- nrow(an05b102_inputs)
n_ppk23_biased <- sum(an05b102_inputs$dominant == "ppk23-biased")
n_ppk25_biased <- sum(an05b102_inputs$dominant == "ppk25-biased")
n_balanced     <- sum(an05b102_inputs$dominant == "balanced")
most_ppk23     <- an05b102_inputs$type[which.max(an05b102_inputs$ppk23_input)]
most_ppk25     <- an05b102_inputs$type[which.max(an05b102_inputs$ppk25_input)]

narrative <- sprintf(
"PANEL N: AN05B102 parallel cholinergic ascending relay
======================================================

WHAT THIS PANEL SHOWS
---------------------
Parallel to Panel B but for the AN05B102 family (%d variants; all cholinergic
/ acetylcholine), which also relays contact-pheromone signals from ppk23/ppk25
sensory neurons on the legs toward brain targets. AN05B102 appears in Figure
5's underlying path feather (roughly 3233 of 18500 cached ppk23->mAL paths
traverse it) but was not rendered as rows in Panels B or K because those
panels scoped to AN09B017.

KEY OBSERVATIONS
----------------
1. The %d AN05B102 variants split: %d ppk23-biased, %d ppk25-biased, %d balanced.
2. %s receives the most ppk23 input; %s receives the most ppk25 input.
3. AN05B102 complements AN09B017 as a second (cholinergic) ascending relay
   family for contact pheromone; both contribute excitatory drive to mAL_m
   but AN05B102 is excitatory via acetylcholine rather than glutamate.

INTERPRETATION
--------------
Adding AN05B102 closes a completeness gap in the relay layer story: the male
contact-pheromone information carried by ppk23 arrives at mAL_m through at
least two parallel ascending-neuron families (AN09B017 glutamatergic in
Panel B; AN05B102 cholinergic here in Panel N), on top of the AN05B035-led
GABAergic sign-inverter pool (Panel M). Panels B and N together show the
excitatory relay landscape; Panel M handles the inhibitory arm.
",
n_variants,
n_variants, n_ppk23_biased, n_ppk25_biased, n_balanced,
most_ppk23, most_ppk25
)

save_panel_narrative("panel_N", narrative)
cat(narrative)
```
